pairs.evidence: packages/stage-kit/src/ui/Overlays.tsx:59 The overlay's only provenance slot is a free-form string from the host (App.tsx sets only "LIVE" or "REPLAY"), yet the stage plays simulation runs whose chat comes from simulated chatters (apps/stage/DESIGN.md:5, daemon runs.rs indexes <runs>/sim/...), so a simulated crowd airs as "N minions" with no "simulated" badge taken from the record.

techniques.evidence: packages/stage-kit/src/ui/Overlays.tsx:59 A badge slot exists, but its text is a free string set by the host with no closed vocabulary. Only LIVE/REPLAY exist, so simulated chat (Platform "sim", EndReason "sim_complete") is never labelled while it airs; the only sim mention is the outro's end reason.

packages/stage-kit/src/ui/VotePanel.tsx:10 In this tool-owns-the-picture page, the vote panel exists only while a poll is active and leaves POLL_LINGER_MS after it closes (onScreen.ts). Outro, EndCard, SealToast and Intro are gated the same way, each on its own domain event.

packages/stage-kit/src/ui/JobTicker.tsx:29 Partial: the empty state that airs is designed rather than left blank. Panel contrast lives in the host's apps/stage styles.css (off-context, index.ts:1-2). No background-matrix or phone-scale review is visible here.

pairs.registryProposal: provenance-badge-opposite-corner assumes one badge per overlay, anchored by that overlay. When the tool owns the whole canvas as one page, the natural slot is a single canvas-level badge (here the top bar). The technique should say how 'opposite corner' maps in that case, as placement-declared-at-provisioning already does with its 'When the tool owns the whole picture' section.

pairs.subject: overlay-composition-and-safe-area
pairs.evidence: packages/stage-kit/src/scene.ts:284 The scene record copies the audience size from stream_start but holds no session mode or audience provenance (no platform, sim or demo field anywhere in sceneModel.ts, scene.ts or parse.ts), so no overlay can take a 'simulated' badge from state, even though the stage replays simulation runs.

techniques.evidence: packages/stage-kit/src/scene.ts:284 Procedure step 1 says the badge text comes from the record of where the data came from. StreamMeta has no mode field. The root cause is upstream: the contract's stream_start event carries no sim flag either.

packages/stage-kit/src/hexgrid.ts:170 The map fit is exactly min(requested cap, area ratios) as one uniform scale (MAP_ZOOM_MAX caps zoom). The whole canvas fits the same way at playback.ts:96, letterboxing the 1920x1080 envelope.

packages/stage-kit/src/screens.test.ts:29 Collisions are checked by computing boxes: fitMap keeps every hex box clear of what stands over the map and inside its area, and tests assert this for 1 to 37 hexes. The bound is the area the host passes, not a player safe area.

packages/stage-kit/src/scene.ts:452 The poll comes into the scene on its open_poll event and nowhere else. A backward seek rebuilds from initialScene (playback.ts:39), so nothing carries over across a reset.
